Capital One Closed Trump Organization Accounts Over AML Concerns

Capital One Financial stated it closed the Trump Organization's bank accounts due to anti-money laundering (AML) concerns. The bank cited a review and adherence to internal policies as the basis for the decision. This disclosure comes in response to a lawsuit filed by the Trump Organization, which alleges the bank acted improperly. The closure of over 300 accounts was reportedly linked to the AML review.
